## Problem and change

Describe the concrete behavior this changes and its compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the relevant behavior checks and the result of the full Linux test command.
Use synthetic fixtures and include privacy/package validation where relevant.

## Review

- [ ] Existing record identities, schemas and lifecycle semantics are preserved,
      or a separately agreed migration is documented.
- [ ] No secrets, private infrastructure, personal data or copied standards.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and changelog reflect the final behavior.
